title: Toggle Link Chain
rhyme: the chain you throw on with your sunglasses for a sunny day out
notes: c01a: open paperclip links, the spring-gate sailor ring with its gate and push-pin nub, and the stone bar threaded through it, as in the listing; the bar reads about the ring's width (the listing has it a little shorter). The sunglasses run off the right edge; calm sand plaster top left for the words.

title: Toggle Link Chain
rhyme: date night: the chain and the rose that comes with it
notes: c02b: open paperclip links, the sailor ring with its gate and nub, and the short stone bar lying across it like a toggle, as in the listing; one small glint by the gate. c02a hung the bar as a long pendant drop. The stem fills the top left, so the words sit at the bottom left in cream.

title: Prism Rivière Bracelet
ingredient: three blank deckle-edged notecards in aqua, blush and butter
rhyme: three blank notecards in the bracelet's own three colours: a note to self to wear all three
notes: c03a: square cushion stones in aqua, pink and yellow, each in its own pavé halo, joined halo to halo in rhodium silver tone, as in the listing; the bracelet lies closed in a loop. The bottom of the loop had two yellow stones side by side, so the first was recoloured to aqua in post (raw/c03a_fix.png): no two neighbours now match, though the order is not a strict aqua, pink, yellow repeat. The cards sit top right; calm grey plaster top left for the words.

title: Prism Rivière Bracelet
rhyme: the pastel stones and the pearl clutch share the same soft colours, after dark
notes: c04a: 16 square cushion stones in aqua, pink and yellow, each in its pavé halo, joined halo to halo with the fold-over box clasp at the end, as in the listing; no two neighbours match. One small star glint on the last yellow stone was removed in post (raw/c04a_fix.png). The clutch sits top right; navy plaster top left for the words, in pearl.

title: Woven Gold Hoops
ingredient: a folded ivory linen shirt, its open collar and mother-of-pearl buttons
rhyme: a white shirt and gold hoops: the effortless classic, chosen on purpose
jobs: 6a7566ac (c05a, kept; hoops scaled to true size)
notes: c05a: an interlaced braid of many fine gold strands, the flat polished disc inside the top and the hinged latch wire, both hoops round and identical, as in the listing. The model drew them about 1.5x true size (3.7 of the shirt's 11 mm buttons across), so they were scaled to 0.64 in post about their own centre, shadows and all, on rebuilt plaster (raw/c05a_s.png): now about 2.4 buttons, true for 25 mm. The shirt fills the upper right; calm oat plaster bottom left for the words. Planned as a knotted silk scarf; the shirt replaced it because a silk knot read as a necktie in round three and the buttons give the hoops a true size.

title: Woven Gold Hoops
ingredient: a black silk folding fan, half open
rhyme: an evening fan and the gold hoops that go with it: the entrance
jobs: 76d4521d (c06a, kept; hoops scaled to true size)
notes: c06a: the same braid, disc and latch, as in the listing; plain black silk leaf on black sticks, no tassel, no pattern. The model drew the hoops about 1.9x true size beside the fan (its sticks only 4.3 hoops long), so they were scaled to 0.55 in post, shadows and all, on rebuilt plaster (raw/c06a_s.png): now about an eighth of the fan's length, true for 25 mm hoops and a 21 cm fan. The fan fills the top; calm oxblood plaster bottom left for the words, in cream. Line changed from the draft Fan favourite., which claims a popularity we have not measured.

title: Verdant Eternity Band
ingredient: the flower head of one white calla lily
rhyme: the bridal flower that is always in bloom, and the eternity band that stays green
jobs: b9768b05 (c07a, ring 2.5x, threaded on the stem)
f3271a47 (c07b, kept; ring set back at true size)
754c176f (clean plate of c07b for the retouch)
notes: c07b: oval emerald-green stones in four claws, the fine pavé wave scalloping between them, the open adjustable back with looped tips, cool silver tone, as in the listing. The model drew the ring about 2.6x true size in both tries (twice as wide as the lily's spadix; c07a threaded it on the stem), so it was set back at 0.42 in post on a clean plate of the same frame (the model removed the ring) with a drawn contact and cast shadow (raw/c07b_r.png): now a sixth of the frame, about a quarter of the flower's length. The flower fills the right; calm sage plaster top left for the words.

title: Verdant Eternity Band

rhyme: dinner in green: the satin clutch and the band that matches it
jobs: f6c32aaa (c08a, ring 1.6x, leaning on the clutch frame)

The clutch fills the top; calm green plaster bottom left for the words, in pale mint.

title: Cushion Halo Ring
ingredient: a blank place card with a thin gold edge and a sprig of baby's breath
rhyme: a seat kept at the wedding table, and the ring that makes someone your plus one
jobs: 86b0ec4c (c09a, kept; ring set back at true size)
bfddba58 (clean plate of c09a for the retouch)
notes: c09a: one round brilliant in four claws inside a single-row cushion halo, pavé down both shoulders, polished silver shank, cool silver tone, as in the listing; the ring stands on its band clear of the card and the sprig. The model drew it about 1.5x true size against the 9 cm card, so it was set back at 0.64 in post on a clean plate of the same frame, scaled from where it stands, its own shadow carried (raw/c09a_r.png). The card carries no writing, only its gold edge. The card fills the upper right; calm dove-grey plaster bottom left for the words.

title: Cushion Halo Ring
ingredient: a small silver chamberstick with a lit ivory candle
rhyme: the evening you ask, by candlelight
jobs: 1c63e963 (c10a, kept; ring set back at true size)
911b0f47 (clean plate of c10a for the retouch)
notes: c10a: the same round brilliant in its single-row cushion halo, pavé shoulders and polished shank, as in the listing, warm with candlelight; the ring stands clear of the chamberstick. The model drew it about 1.6x true size (1.7 candle widths across), so it was set back at 0.62 in post on a clean plate of the same frame, scaled from where it stands; the rising arms of one star glint on the halo were removed, leaving a point of light (raw/c10a_r.png). One small natural flame. The chamberstick fills the upper right; calm plum plaster bottom left for the words, in cream.
